# scope-finish: bring the VectorScope lane (#73) up to main before review

Branch `scope-finish` (PR #73, draft). No feature flag changes.

## 2026-11-23, merge prep against origin/main `ab4b352d`

**Merge.** `origin/scope-finish` already held origin/main `ab4b352d` (#85) through the integration merge `cc0c6a4b`, so `git merge origin/main` was a no-op. Main changed none of #73's files since #73's earlier base `6601d963` (#67), so no conflicts were left to resolve.

**Generated files.** Main added the optional `tightenBudget` field to the session prompt request in `packages/protocol/src/groups/session.ts`. The commit is `05fa5518`, which reached main with #78; the regeneration commit's message names #83 by mistake. The engine serves that group, so the SDK's input changed while main's `packages/sdk/openapi.json` stayed as it was. `bun run build` in `packages/sdk/js` (the SDK generator) added the field to `packages/sdk/openapi.json` and to the v1 and v2 `types.gen.ts` and `sdk.gen.ts` files, 7 lines in all, unedited. The config schema already matched its generator (`test/compliance/generated-artifacts.test.ts`). `bun run check:generated` in `packages/client` showed no difference. No test compares the SDK with its generator; the generator run is the check.

**Typechecks.** `bun typecheck` passed in app, core, engine, schema, sdk/js (again after the regeneration) and server. `tsgo -p script/vectorscope-eval/tsconfig.json` passed.

**Tests.** Each file was run alone from its package with `--timeout 30000`. The engine files were picked because they import, directly or within three steps, the engine sources main changed: `session/instruction.ts` (EV-21, #70), `task/manager.ts` and `task/signals.ts` (#84).

- engine: `tool/task` 161, `review/run` 106, `review/eval` 57, `review/knowledge` 4, `review/narrative-invariance` 3, `tool/holdback-tools` 14, `tool/registry` 28, `cli/review-batch` 3, `cli/review-batch-privacy` 1, `cli/review-strict` 13, `cli/review-fix` 9, `cli/review-connect-cache` 1, `cli/review-dispatch` 2, `cli/review-holdback` 6, `cli/review-impact` 2, `cli/review-pr-verdict` 3, `cli/review-privacy` 10, `cli/review-trivial` 4, `cli/github.review` 54, `cli/review.render` 14, `review/run-batch` 5, `review/run-impact` 1, `review/run-strict` 8, `review/service` 2, `review/fix` 1, `review/vectorscope-replay` 29, `session/code-review-flow` 6, `session/review-request-preparation` 1, `session/holdback-tools` 2, `session/system` 23, `session/llm-request` 47, `server/httpapi-public-openapi` 21, `server/httpapi-review-privacy` 6, `server/httpapi-review-fix` 5, `compliance/generated-artifacts` 3, `config/config` 180, `config/subagent-config` 16. All passed. The hosted Verify air-gap job runs the bubblewrap cases for `review/fix` with `VECTOR_FIX_SANDBOX_CI=1`. Ordinary engine shards run the refusal cases for environments without a working sandbox.
- core: `review/model-evidence` 37 (the pipeline digest still matches), `review/local-result` 26.

**About this machine.** This Mac has no `rg` on PATH. The grep, glob and Brain link cases in `review/run`, `review/eval`, `review/knowledge` and `tool/holdback-tools` fail without it ("ripgrep execution failed"). They passed once a local ripgrep 14.1.1 was put on PATH. `review/vectorscope-replay` has four subprocess cases that fail when TMPDIR is the default `/var/folders/...` path, which is a symlink to `/private/var/...`. In that case `ReviewEval` in `packages/engine/src/review/eval.ts` (the check at about line 620) compares the instance directory with the case directory using `path.resolve`, which does not follow symlinks, and refuses with "A replay runs in an engine instance on its checkout". With a TMPDIR that has no symlink in its path, all 29 cases passed. None of this comes from the merge. The replay comparison is noted for the #73 review.
